schema:funding.schema:name: CNSA pre-research project D020205; NSFC 41973013; Natural Science Foundation of Hubei Province 2020CFA045; GPMR State Key Laboratory special fund MSFGPMR04 and MSFGPMR08

ada:transectLength: Variable; analyses of plagioclase, pyroxene, glass in two lunar meteorites (NWA 10597 and NWA 6950); line length varies by mineral grain size
ada:withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAndA: Standard error (USE = SE at 95% confidence) for 87Sr/86Sr and 87Rb/86Sr per individual run; dependent on signal intensity (regression shown in Fig. 3); relative errors for 87Rb/86Sr: ±3% for most reference glasses; 87Sr/86Sr relative errors: <0.2‰ for materials with 87Rb/86Sr <1
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: 87Sr/86Sr relative errors <0.2‰ for reference materials with 87Rb/86Sr <1 (12 of 14 reference materials); 87Rb/86Sr relative accuracy within ±3% for 11 glasses; exceptions: NIST 610 (−2.97%), NIST 612 (+2.02%), ATHO-G (+2.89%) — all within stated ±3% criterion

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: In situ — polished thin section (two-volume cell)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Laser Fluence (Energy Density)
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: ~60% of maximum output (PHAROS system; exact J cm⁻² not converted)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 2–6 µm s⁻¹ (varied based on Sr concentration in target minerals)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Ar make-up (flow rate not separately stated); N₂ 12 ml min⁻¹ added via Y-connector downstream of signal-smoothing device

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Signal Smoothing
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Signal-smoothing device used downstream from ablation cell (model not specified); significantly reduced short-term signal variability

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: NIST 610 used to optimize He/Ar gas flows, torch position, RF power, and source lens settings for max sensitivity and peak flatness; small N₂ added downstream

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Sequence
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 14 reference glasses analyzed to evaluate accuracy and provide calibration factors; natural minerals as unknowns for data quality evaluation; 1 block of 120 cycles per analysis

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Standard error (SE = SD/√n) for repeatability within individual runs; assessed separately for 87Sr/86Sr and 87Rb/86Sr using signal intensity regression

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Cycles with 87Rb/86Sr >1 deleted (invalid Rb interference correction); cycles with 88Sr signal <0.2 V discarded (poor precision); SUIA method applied to heterogeneous minerals

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: ⁸⁸Sr/⁸⁶Sr = 8.37520933 used for Sr isotope mass fractionation correction (exponential law); ⁸⁷Rb/⁸⁵Rb = 0.385706 and ⁸⁶Sr/⁸⁸Sr = 0.119351 for ⁸⁷Rb/⁸⁶Sr calculation; external calibration factor from reference glasses applied to correct Rb/Sr elemental fractionation

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: NIST 610 for instrument parameter optimization; series of reference glasses (NIST 612, BHVO-2G, BCR-2G, NKT-1G, TB-1G, ATHO-G, KL2-G, ML3B-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G) for external calibration of ⁸⁷Rb/⁸⁶Sr ratio; natural clinopyroxenes (NHB-9, YY12-01) and anorthite (YG4301) as unknown samples for ⁸⁷Sr/⁸⁶Sr data quality evaluation

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Secondary Reference Materials
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Natural clinopyroxenes NHB-9 and YY12-01 (reference values given in Table 2); anorthite YG4301 — measured as unknowns for 87Sr/86Sr data quality evaluation
